title: Bagging, out-of-bag error, and gradient boosting
brief: Average bootstrapped stumps, score them on the rows they never saw, and build gradient boosting from residuals.
hints: bootstrap_indices is one call to rng.integers(0, n, size=n): n draws with replacement from {0, ..., n-1}.
bagging_variance is a one-line evaluation of rho * sigma2 + (1 - rho) * sigma2 / B.

fit_bagged_stumps should call bootstrap_indices once per estimator, fit a stump on that resample with the provided _fit_stump helper, and remember which indices were drawn so out_of_bag_error knows which trees to trust for which point.

In gradient_boost, initialise F to zeros, and at every round set target = loss_grad(y, F), fit a stump to (X, target), then update F += learning_rate * stump_predictions. Record the target and the updated F at every round; the checks inspect both.
